<h2>Plot Manuscript Spatial Variance Partitioning</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds the shared two-panel variance-partitioning figure used for paleo and
modern results: normalized component composition and unit-level association
spread with median and 95 percent interval.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>plot_manuscript_spatial_variance(
  data_plot,
  data_component_summary,
  data_biotic_summary
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_plot">data_plot</code></td>
<td>
<p>Prepared unit-level spatial variance data.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_component_summary">data_component_summary</code></td>
<td>
<p>Grouped component-composition data.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_biotic_summary">data_biotic_summary</code></td>
<td>
<p>Grouped association summary data.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A 'cowplot' assembled plot object.
</p>

</main>
